We are pleased to announce the release of pandas ${VERSION}.
This is a patch release in the ${MINOR_VERSION}.x series and includes some regression fixes and bug fixes. We recommend that all users of the ${MINOR_VERSION}.x series upgrade to this version.

See the [full whatsnew](https://pandas.pydata.org/pandas-docs/version/${MINOR_VERSION}/whatsnew/v${VERSION}.html) for a list of all the changes.

The release can be installed from PyPI:

    python -m pip install --upgrade pandas==${MINOR_VERSION}.*

Or from conda-forge

    conda install -c conda-forge pandas=${MINOR_VERSION}

Please report any issues with the release on the [pandas issue tracker](https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/issues).

Thanks to all the contributors who made this release possible.
